p='/inputs/providers.py'
old='model calls are off; set SKILLC_ALLOW_MODEL_CALLS=1 for a deliberate run'
new='model calls are disabled; opt in explicitly before running a model'
s=open(p).read()
try:
    with open(p,'r+') as f:
        f.seek(0); f.write(s.replace(old,new,1)); f.truncate()
    print('written')
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__, e)
print('unchanged:', open(p).read()==s)
